{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# Look at the first few values of revenue
revenue_sample = df['revenue'].head()

# Check if any contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many have commas
comma_count = has_commas.sum()

revenue_sample, comma_count"}
